note: Independent source rejudgment against full RFC 9234 Sections 3.1, 4.2 and 5. TestOTCEgressFilter exercises exact suppression of non-Customer-learned routes toward Provider, Peer and RS and exact acceptance controls toward Customer/RS-Client and for Customer-learned transit. Its no-OTC inputs and config-less source cases isolate source-role suppression from the wire OTC gate and source export-set gate; TestOTCEgressSuppressProviderLearnedWithoutMeta additionally proves the configured source-role fallback without metadata. The destination local role additions make each RFC destination gate applicable under Section 4.2, complementary to the previously supplied remote role, without changing payloads or assertions. The Customer/local-origin and RS forwarding sentences are MAY permissions, not unconditional forwarding requirements that override operator policy. OTCEgressFilter and resolveSrcRole implement the asserted scope. Existing positive/negative TestOTCEgressFilter discrimination records require renewal for the changed unit/producer. This is source judgment, not a claim that corrected tests or producer-break proofs have run.
